title: Developer for Mixed-Income Affordable Housing Project
short_description: Developer sought for design, financing, construction, and management of affordable housing in South Miami.
project_location: 5890 SW 69th Street, South Miami, Florida, USA
project_scope: Development of a mixed-income affordable housing project on City-owned property at 5890 SW 69th Street, including design, financing, construction, and management. No technical data such as gross floor area, number of units, height, or structural system is stated in the source.
services: Design-build/developer services for design, financing, development, and management of the housing project.
relevance_explanation:
- Residential housing project with no stated structural complexity or special long-span features.
- Procurement is primarily for a developer/design-build entity rather than focused structural engineering services.
- No information on innovative materials, sustainability targets, or architecturally demanding structures.
- Could involve building design, but current notice offers limited strategic fit for sbp.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction budget is stated in the source. Useful missing inputs for an estimate include number of housing units, gross floor area, building height, parking scope, site area, quality standard, and whether podium or special structural systems are planned.
fee_explanation: No fee information is stated in the source, and no realistic sbp fee estimate is possible because the structural scope, project size, and procurement model are not defined.
references_qualifications: Proposers must be highly qualified individuals, associations, corporations, joint ventures, or partnerships with the requisite skill, experience, and financial strength for design, financing, development, and management of the project.

notes: Project number: CSM2026-08. Agency ID: 8250. Pre-submittal meeting: 07/16/2026 10:00 AM EDT at City Hall Chambers, 6130 Sunset Drive, South Miami, FL 33143; attendance recommended. Questions deadline: 07/24/2026 10:00 AM EDT. Source classifies target market as General Building.
